state.image: A drowned monastery remembering that it was once a forest. A symmetrical ruined Gothic cathedral fills the center. A rose window at (0.50,0.30); ribbed arches rise between x=0.25 and 0.75. Tree roots swallow columns from both sides. Luminous fungi sprout from stone. The lower third is dark water reflecting the architecture. The upper corners are night sky. Blue silver light from the window, amber fungi, deep teal water. Perspective view down the central nave.
